The candidate will be responsible for supporting product design and development activities, developing and reviewing mechanical engineering drawings, performing tolerance stack-up analysis, and ensuring product functionality, dimensional accuracy, reliability and manufacturability. Evaluate design concepts for functionality, manufacturability, assembly requirements and dimensional performance. Collaborate with Design, Manufacturing, Quality and Supplier Engineering teams to resolve design and dimensional challenges. Review supplier drawings, CMM reports and dimensional inspection results to ensure compliance with engineering specifications. Support design reviews, engineering changes, design verification and validation activities. Perform root cause analysis and support corrective actions for design-related and dimensional nonconformances. Apply DFM and DFA principles to improve product design, manufacturing efficiency and assembly processes. Maintain engineering drawings, design documentation and technical records in accordance with applicable medical device quality requirements. Preferred Skills 5–10 years of experience in Product Development, Mechanical Design or Product Design Engineering within the Medical Device / MedTech industry. Strong hands-on experience in GD&T and ASME Y14.5 standards. Experience performing 1D and 3D tolerance stack-up analysis for mechanical components and assemblies. Proficiency in engineering drawing interpretation, dimensional tolerancing, datum schemes and geometric controls. Experience with CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks or Siemens NX. Exposure to tolerance analysis tools such as CETOL or 3DCS. Knowledge of mechanical design, precision components, material selection and manufacturing processes. Experience with CMM, dimensional inspection and measurement techniques. Understanding of ISO 13485, DFM, DFA and medical device product development lifecycle. Strong analytical, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.
